integrity: The formula follows from locally complete singleton-avoidance counts and a full invariant decomposition of the exact transfer operator. Included standard-library code supplies finite structurally different cross-checks, not a substitute for the infinite proof. No independent external audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The exact polynomial applies to labeled proper open-neighborhood conflict-free colorings of uniform pendant-multiplicity cycle coronas for n≥3, a≥1. It makes no claim about arbitrary attached rooted trees or arbitrary list assignments, and does not assert a new three-color chromatic number. Unindexed equivalent enumerations remain possible.
title: A four-mode counting law for proper conflict-free colorings of hairy cycles
